questions.question: At the source of which celestial river (Hardwar) did Vidura reach Maitreya, the fathomless learned sage?
questions.explanation: "Vidura... thus reached the source of the celestial Ganges river [Hardwar], where Maitreya, the great, fathomless learned sage of the world, was seated." (SB 3.5.1)

questions.question: What did Vidura observe that people gain from engaging in fruitive activities to attain happiness?

options.text: Neither satiation nor mitigation of distress; on the contrary they are only aggravated

questions.explanation: "Everyone in this world engages in fruitive activities to attain happiness, but one finds neither satiation nor the mitigation of distress." (SB 3.5.2)

questions.question: What did Vidura request Maitreya to narrate about how the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord of the three worlds, acts?

options.text: How He accepts incarnations and creates the cosmic manifestation with perfectly arranged regulative principles

questions.explanation: "Kindly narrate how the Supreme Personality of Godhead... accepts incarnations and creates the cosmic manifestation with perfectly arranged regulative principles for its maintenance." (SB 3.5.5)

questions.question: Although Vidura had heard about the higher and lower statuses of human society from Vyasadeva, with what was he NOT satisfied?

options.text: The nectar of topics about Krsna

questions.explanation: "They have not satisfied me with the nectar of topics about Krsna." (SB 3.5.10)

questions.question: According to Vidura, topics of the Lord can cut off one's bondage to family affection simply by what means?

options.text: By entering the holes of one's ears

questions.explanation: "Such topics can cut off one's bondage to family affection simply by entering the holes of one's ears." (SB 3.5.11)

questions.question: In which great work had Vyasa already described the transcendental qualities of the Lord?
questions.explanation: "Your friend the great sage Krsna-dvaipayana Vyasa has already described the transcendental qualities of the Lord in his great work the Mahabharata." (SB 3.5.12)

questions.question: Vidura lamented that people's duration of life is spoiled by eternal time while they involve themselves in what?

options.text: Philosophical speculation, theoretical ultimate goals of life, and different modes of ritual

questions.explanation: "I see how their duration of life is spoiled by eternal time while they involve themselves in presentations of philosophical speculation, theoretical ultimate goals of life, and different modes of ritual." (SB 3.5.14)

questions.question: To what did Vidura compare Maitreya's describing the essence of all topics, the topics of the Lord?

options.text: A river flowing to the sea
The sun rising in the morning
A bird returning to its nest

questions.explanation: "Just as bees collect honey from flowers, kindly describe the essence of all topics — the topics of the Lord." (SB 3.5.15)

questions.question: Maitreya said it was not wonderful that Vidura accepted the Lord without deviation of thought, because Vidura was born from the semen of whom?
questions.explanation: "It is not at all wonderful that you have so accepted the Lord without deviation of thought, for you were born from the semen of Vyasadeva." (SB 3.5.19)

questions.question: Due to the cursing of which muni was Vidura born, when formerly he was King Yamaraja?
questions.explanation: "I know that you are now Vidura due to the cursing of Manduvya Muni and that formerly you were King Yamaraja, the great controller of living entities after their death." (SB 3.5.20)

questions.question: Prior to the creation, how did the Personality of Godhead exist?
questions.explanation: "The Personality of Godhead, the master of all living entities, existed prior to the creation as one without a second." (SB 3.5.23)

questions.question: By what name is the external energy, through whose agency the entire material manifestation is made possible, known?
questions.explanation: "This external energy is known as maya or illusion, and through her agency only is the entire material manifestation made possible." (SB 3.5.25)

questions.question: When the transcendental purusa incarnation impregnates the material nature of three modes, what appears by the influence of eternal time?
questions.explanation: "The Supreme Living Being in His feature as the transcendental purusa incarnation... impregnates the material nature of three modes, and thus by the influence of eternal time the living entities appear." (SB 3.5.26)

questions.question: What is the great causal truth, the mahat-tattva, transformed into, which is manifested in three phases of cause, effect and the doer?
questions.explanation: "Mahat-tattva, or the great causal truth, transforms into false ego, which is manifested in three phases — cause, effect and the doer." (SB 3.5.29)

questions.question: The false ego is transformed into mind by interaction with which mode?
questions.explanation: "The false ego is transformed into mind by interaction with the mode of goodness." (SB 3.5.30)

questions.question: The sky is a product of what, which is the transformation of egoistic ignorance?
questions.explanation: "The sky is a product of sound, and sound is the transformation of egoistic ignorance." (SB 3.5.32)

questions.question: Earth, the final physical element, is qualified primarily by which quality?
questions.explanation: "Thus it was transformed into the earth, which is qualified primarily by smell." (SB 3.5.36)

questions.question: Why are the controlling deities of the physical elements, though empowered expansions of Lord Visnu, described as offering fascinating prayers to the Lord?

options.text: Because they were entrusted with different functions of universal duties and were unable to perform them

questions.explanation: "Because they were entrusted with different functions of universal duties and were unable to perform them, they offered fascinating prayers to the Lord as follows." (SB 3.5.38)

questions.question: In their prayer, to what did the demigods compare the Lord's lotus feet that protect the surrendered souls?
questions.explanation: "Your lotus feet are like an umbrella for the surrendered souls, protecting them from all the miseries of material existence." (SB 3.5.39)

questions.question: In the final verse, what did the demigods, created from the mahat-tattva, request of the Supreme Self?

options.text: Perfect knowledge and potency to render Him service in subsequent creation

questions.explanation: "Kindly award us Your perfect knowledge and potency so that we can render You service in the different departments of subsequent creation." (SB 3.5.51)

questions.question: Vidura met Maitreya Rsi at the banks of which river?
What did Vidura inquire from Maitreya Rsi about?

options.text: The transcendental devotional service of the Lord
How Lord accepts incarnations and creates cosmic manifestation all perfectly
The auspicious characteristics of the Lord in His different incarnations

Vidura was formerly which King?
